chapter: Early drum sets and dance-hall era
title: Tempo, Faiso, Red Happy and Chani
summary: He demonstrates the old medium tempo and ranks Faiso best, with Happy and Chani also remembered.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, I never was too much interested in the people dancing what they would play. Well, I was interested in that drummer listening that he played. Mm-hmm.
Well, how fast would they play then? Would they play as fast as they do now or faster or what? Well, no.
They had a, what you say, a medium tempo that they should play.
Yeah. Could you beat it off a little? For me? With your foot just so we can pick it up?

Let's see if I can get that. Most of their numbers was on the tempo like this. Like on the jump tempo. Put the microphone next to your foot out. I'll do it again then. Once it. That's most of the tempo, but they didn't play on the full full time like I'm playing. That guys, most of the drummers had that one beat. That was their beat, most of them. Whatever they played, they had that one beat. Now this guy, Faso, I say he was up until, the style he played now, he was playing a similar, you know, kind of the style the guys are playing today. He was playing that time, during that time back. He was just, I always just say he was, they claimed Happy was the best drummer around here, and Chani, but to my estimation, I always thought Faso was the best drummer. Which Happy? Followed by the name of Red Happy, used to play at the Larricks Theater. Now much as I went to the Larricks, I couldn't even tell you nothing about Happy. I can't recall him, I can't even place him. I don't remember the guy that was. But I heard him talk about Happy, and I used to go to the Larricks. I really can't place him, can't pitch him no kind of ways. Chani, he was a fine drummer too. Used to play with Papa's band, Papa's Selleckstands band. I remember him playing. He's a guy, one of those guys, put a drummer, shoulder sticks up in there and catch him, and he'd make a lot of stuff, man. He was a fine drummer too.
